title: The Doctor Who Stole Albert Einstein's Brain in a Jar
lines: The most famous brain in history vanished right off the autopsy table.
In 1955, pathologist Thomas Harvey conducted Albert Einstein's routine autopsy.
Einstein specifically demanded his body be cremated without any study.
Instead, Harvey quietly removed the entire brain and walked outside.
He lost his medical license, his wife, and his job.
Yet he refused to surrender it to any university.
He chopped it into two hundred and forty glass slides.
Then stored the remaining chunks inside two ordinary mason jars.
For forty years, he kept the jars in a beer cooler.
He even drove it across America in the trunk of his Buick.
And it took four decades before anyone realized...
